subject: Scheduling: Product demo with Horizon Health — timezone options
messages:
From: Tom Walker <tom.walker@horizonhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Rossi <marta.rossi@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 13:13:00 -0800
Subject: Quick — demo timing question

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the fast response last week. We are excited to see Redwood’s Hosted API in action. Our leadership is available next Thursday, Dec 3, at 4:00 PM PT — would that work for your team? That would be 01:00 CET for Europe, which I realize is late. If that’s not possible, can you propose two alternatives that keep it in our business hours (PT morning or midday)?

Attendees: myself (Director of IT), Marta (Head of Integrations), and potentially a solution architect.

Thanks — Tom

—
Tom Walker
Director of IT, Horizon Health
Tom.Walker@horizonhealth.com
+1 415-555-0192
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Walker <tom.walker@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Marta Rossi <marta.rossi@horizonhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:07:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Quick — demo timing question

Hi Tom — great to hear from you.

We can absolutely do a demo; Dec 3 at 16:00 PT would be 01:00 CET and that’s not feasible for our EMEA engineers. Two quick options that we commonly use for cross-region exec + engineering attendance:

1) Move the session to a PT morning slot (08:00–10:00 PT) so it’s late afternoon in CET (17:00–19:00 CET). That keeps execs in the US comfortable and lets our EU engineers join without being overnight.
2) Keep the PT time you suggested for a short executive walkthrough (30 minutes) with a promised recorded deep-dive for technical teams. We can follow up next-morning CET with a 45-minute handoff for engineers.

If you have a hard constraint on PT afternoon, we can try a rotating-host model where an APAC-friendly engineer records the deep dive and an EU engineer joins the live Q&A (we’ve done this successfully before).

I’ve looped in Karthik (customer success) to help coordinate availability and Jonas (EMEA solutions) to confirm EU engineer windows. Attached is a short agenda and a draft SOW to help frame the session.

Proposed CTAs: please confirm whether you prefer (1) a single shifted slot (PT morning / CET late afternoon) or (2) split — exec live then recorded technical deep-dive + follow-up Q&A.

Cheers,
Mina

—
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf (1 page), SOW-draft.docx (draft)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Walker <tom.walker@horizonhealth.com>, Marta Rossi <marta.rossi@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Quick — demo timing question

Hi all — quick availability note from the EMEA engineering side. Our core infra/engineers can join reliably between 09:00–12:00 CET and 16:00–18:30 CET on most weekdays. Late-night (00:00–02:00 CET) live sessions are a hard no — we’d only do that in an emergency.

If Horizon prefers a PT afternoon for execs, the best compromise is Mina’s option (2): a 30-minute executive walkthrough live at 16:00 PT, followed by a recorded technical session our engineering team prepares and hands off to your architects the next morning (we’ll include an engineering Q&A at 10:00 CET the following day).

Small practical note on DST: the US recently finished DST changes and the offset to CET is stable right now, but it’s worth calling out when we exchange calendar invites across tools — Outlook sometimes shows old offsets for recurring invites.

Happy to host the engineer Q&A next day (I’ll be on camera).

Best,
Jonas

—
Jonas Weber
Lead Solutions Engineer, EMEA, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
From: Tom Walker <tom.walker@horizonhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Rossi <marta.rossi@horizonhealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick — demo timing question

Thanks, Mina and Jonas — that makes sense. I’d prefer option (2): keep the exec slot in our PT afternoon for leadership (we need their live presence) and do the recorded deep-dive + engineering Q&A the next day.

Can we do:
- Exec walkthrough: Thu, Dec 3, 2026 16:00–16:30 PT (30 min)
- Recorded technical deep-dive: delivered by Redwood by Fri, Dec 4 morning PT
- Engineering Q&A: Fri, Dec 4, 2026 10:00 CET (live, 45 min)

If that plan works for you, we’ll send a calendar hold for the exec slot and the Q&A. Please confirm presenters for each session so I can include final invites.

Tom
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Walker <tom.walker@horizonhealth.com>, Marta Rossi <marta.rossi@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick — demo timing question

That works — confirmed on our side. Final presenters: Mina (exec walkthrough) and Jonas (engineering Q&A). Karthik will own the recording delivery and SOW follow-up.

I’ll post two calendar invites shortly (exec live — Dec 3 16:00 PT / recorded delivery + live Q&A — Dec 4 10:00 CET). Note on invites: please accept the times shown in your primary calendar and double-check time zone conversion (Outlook web sometimes applies the wrong offset for imported .ics).

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the demo.

—
Mina
